promotion_policy: STABLE zawiera tylko wersje potwierdzone w testach. Nowe funkcje i poprawki najpierw trafiają do BETA.

versions.label: 10.4 BETA — FRIENDS 2.0 + FAST UI
versions.notes: Friends 2.0 keeps Radar 9.7 intact but adds human-readable ONLINE/APP/GOTOWY DO APP/BRAK ID states, a prominent user-triggered Sync APP action for known IDs, and an APP refresh when the Friends panel is explicitly opened. Fast Themes renders the theme panel immediately instead of waiting on the older UI observer. Color Writing gains native CZATeria Bold and Italic controls using userMessageStyle/msgIsBold/msgIsItalic, without transforming message text. Notify 10.3 remains the notification engine and VIP stays removed.
